allowedSourceMaterial.overview: Akira Kurosawa's lauded feudal epic presents the tale of a petty thief who is recruited to impersonate Shingen, an aging warlord, in order to avoid attacks by competing clans. When Shingen dies, his generals reluctantly agree to have the impostor take over as the powerful ruler. He soon begins to appreciate life as Shingen, but his commitment to the role is tested when he must lead his troops into battle against the forces of a rival warlord.

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: Can an untrained rogue uphold an entire dynasty's survival when rival armies force him onto an active battlefield?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: In Akira Kurosawa's feudal epic, a petty thief is recruited to double for the aging warlord Shingen. After Shingen dies, reluctant generals preserve the ruse, thrusting the double into command against rival clans.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Heavy, thoughtful, and suspenseful; a long-form feudal war drama built for focused solo viewing.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Kurosawa frames power and persona through a high-stakes deception, matching grand martial scale with the heavy moral weight of a thief forced into leadership.
